blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Full-duplex speech systems must decide when to enter, hold, or relinquish the conversational floor, even as multiple speakers overlap or backchannel without taking it. Existing evaluations study dyadic turn-taking or end-to-end agent behavior, but lack a unified, controlled evaluation of genuine floor transitions against confusable non-events in multi-party settings. We introduce MultiPartyTurnBench (MPTB), a benchmark of 240 synthetically generated, channel-separated conversations spanning two to five speakers and six interaction types. MPTB evaluates two complementary tasks: End-of-Turn (EOT) detection distinguishes genuine turn completion from temporary holds, while Interruption (INT) detection distinguishes successful floor takeovers from non-floor-taking speech. Exact event-conditioned annotations enable causal evaluation using false-positive-constrained recall and signed latency. Across acoustic, semantic, and turn-projection baselines, we find a stark asymmetry: learned systems achieve 82.5-92.6% EOT recall at 4.3-11.8% false-positive rates, while INT detection suffers from missed takeovers or excessive false activations. This asymmetry extends to five full-duplex agents which achieve 86.1-95.8% balanced accuracy on turn entry, yet perform near chance (46.9-54.7%) on selective interruption handling. Gemini-3.8-Live yields to 97.7% of backchannels, whereas MiniCPM-o-4.5 yields to only 1.4% of genuine interruptions. These findings establish selective floor control as a distinct, unresolved challenge for reliable multi-party voice interaction.
blocks.zh: 完全繁复的语音系统必须决定何时进入,持有,或放弃对话层,即使多个演讲者重叠或反通道而不接听. 现有评价研究dyadic转录或端到端代理行为,但缺乏针对多党环境下的不相容非事件,对真正底层过渡的统一,有控制的评价. 我们引入了多方Turn Bench(MPTB),这是240个合成、频道隔开的对话的基准,涉及两到五个发言者和六种互动类型。 MPTB评价两个互补的任务: 最终(EOT)检测区分真转完成与临时搁置,而中断(INT)检测则区分成功地层接管与非地层占用演讲. 精确的事件附加说明允许使用假阳性限制的召回和签名的暂时性进行因果关系评估。 纵观声学、语义学和转弯投影基线,我们发现一个明显的不对称现象:所学的系统以4.3-11.8 %的假阳性率实现了82.5-92.6%的EOT召回率,而INT检测则受到丢失接管或过度的假激活的影响。 这种不对称现象延伸到五个完全复方剂,在转录时达到86.1%至95.8%的平衡精度,但在选择性中断处理时却几乎偶然(46.9至54.7%)。 双子座-3.8-寿命的产率为97.7%,而微型CPM-o-4.5的产率为1.4%。 这些调查结果确定了有选择的底线控制,作为可靠多党派声音互动的独特、未解决的挑战。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Full-duplex speech systems must continuously decide when to enter, hold, or relinquish the conversational floor while processing ongoing speech ( Ekstedt and Skantze, 2022 ; Peng et al., 2025 ) . These decisions require more than detecting speech activity: a speaker may pause without yielding the floor, while a listener may backchannel without attempting to take it ( Sacks et al., 1974 ; Yngve, 1970 ) . Misinterpreting either can cause an agent to respond prematurely or unnecessarily abandon its own response, even when its language understanding is otherwise correct ( Xia et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 完全繁复的语音系统必须持续决定何时进入、持有或放弃对话层,同时处理正在进行的语音(Ekstedt和Skantze,2022;Peng等人,2025)。 这些决定要求的不仅仅是检测言论活动:发言者可以暂停发言而不发言,而听众可以不尝试发言而回话(Sacks等人,1974年;Yngve,1970年)。 误判要么可能导致代理人反应过早,要么不必要地放弃自己的反应,即使其语言理解在其他方面是正确的(Xia等,2026.).

blocks.en: This distinction becomes particularly important in multi-party conversation, where several listeners may backchannel, overlap, or interject while the current speaker retains the floor. Existing evaluations address complementary aspects of this problem: dyadic benchmarks distinguish turn endings and interruptions in 2-party settings ( Jiang and others, 2026 ; Xia et al., 2026 ) , natural multi-party corpora study next-speaker prediction ( Triadic-VAP, 2025 ; Qi and Skantze, 2026 ) , and full-duplex agent benchmarks assess speaking and stopping behavior ( Lin and others, 2025 ; Lin and others, 2026 ; Ma et al., 2026 ) . However, the joint evaluation of genuine floor relinquishment and successful floor acquisition under controlled multi-party conditions remains underexplored.
blocks.zh: 这种区分在多党对话中变得特别重要,在多党对话中,几位听众可能回馈、重叠或插嘴,而现任发言者则保留发言。 现有评价涉及这一问题的互补方面:dyadic基准区分了在两党环境下的转折和中断(Jiang等,2026;Xia等,2026;Triadic-VAP,2025;Qi和Skantze,2026;),自然多党公司研究下一语言预测(Triadic-VAP,2025;Qi和Skantze,2026;全复式代理基准评估发言和停止行为(Lin等,2025;Lin等,2026;Ma等,2026). 然而,对在受控多党条件下真正放弃楼层和成功购置楼层的联合评价仍然不足。

blocks.en: We introduce MultiPartyTurnBench (Fig. 1 ), a benchmark for evaluating floor control in multi-party full-duplex speech. MPTB evaluates two complementary decisions: End-of-Turn ( EOT ) detection distinguishes genuine turn completion from temporary holds, while Interruption ( INT ) detection distinguishes successful floor takeovers from backchannels and other non-floor-taking speech. The benchmark comprises 240 synthetically generated, channel-separated conversations balanced across N ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } N\in\{2,3,4,5\} speakers and six interaction types. A discrete-event orchestrator establishes floor ownership and event timing before speech synthesis, enabling controlled variation in speaker count, interaction dynamics, and acoustic conditions. We evaluate acoustic, semantic, and turn-projection systems through causal event detection with false-positive-constrained recall and signed latency, complemented by real-speech validation and interactive testing of full-duplex agents.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了多方Turn Bench(图1),这是在多方全方位演讲中评价底部控制的基准. MPTB评价两项补充决定: 倒转(EOT)检测区分了真正的倒转完成与临时被扣,而中断(INT)检测则区分了成功地层接管与后道和其他非地层取走的演讲. 该基准包括240个合成生成的、频道分离的谈话,在N{{{2、3、4、5}之间平衡,N\in}2,3,4,5}的演讲者和6个互动类型。 离散事件管弦乐手在语音合成前确定会场所有权和会场时间,从而在演讲者计数、互动动态和声学条件方面实现可控变化。 我们通过因果事件检测评估声学、语义学和转动投影系统,通过假阳性-受约束的召回和签名延缓,辅之以真实的语音验证和对全复试剂的互动测试。

blocks.en: Main Results. Our evaluation reveals a pronounced asymmetry between turn completion and successful floor acquisition. At qualified operating points, systems recover up to 92.6% of turn endings but only 56.2% of successful interruptions; acoustic detectors achieve higher recall only at excessive false-positive rates. Increasing speaker count produces jagged degradation, while conversational style exposes substantial model-specific interruption failures. Crucially, this asymmetry extends to observable voice agent behavior: four of five full-duplex agents achieve 86.1–95.8% balanced accuracy on turn entry, yet all five remain near chance (46.9–54.7%) on selective yielding. Gemini-3.8-Live ( Google, 2026 ) yields almost indiscriminately, whereas MiniCPM-o-4.5 ( Cui et al., 2026 ) rarely yields even to genuine interruptions, revealing opposite failures concealed by aggregate accuracy. Complementary real-speech evaluation further shows that interruption detection remains challenging in natural multi-party meetings. These findings establish selective interruption handling as a persistent limitation of multi-party full-duplex interaction. Our main contributions are: • MultiPartyTurnBench , a controlled benchmark of 240 multi-party conversations spanning two to five speakers and six interaction types, with exact event-state annotations for end-of-turn (EOT) and interruption (INT) detection. • A systematic evaluation of floor-transition detection across acoustic, semantic, and turn-projection systems, revealing an EOT–INT capability gap and model-specific sensitivities to speaker count and conversational style. • End-to-end validation across five full-duplex voice agents , exposing near-chance selective yielding despite strong turn-entry performance, with opposing tendencies to yield indiscriminately or ignore genuine interruptions.
blocks.zh: 主要成果。 我们的评价显示,转弯完成和成功购置楼层之间明显不对称。 在合格的操作点,系统恢复了92.6%的转折,但只有56.2%的成功中断;声学探测器只在超高的假阳性速率下才能实现更高的回回. 不断增长的演讲者计数会产生扭曲的退化,而对话风格则暴露出针对模型的重大中断故障. 关键是,这种不对称延伸至可观察到的语音代理行为:五个全复式代理中,四个在转机输入时实现了86.1%-95.8%的平衡准确性,然而所有五个在选择性交接时都保持了接近概率(46.9-54.7%)。 双子座-3.8-活(Google,2026年)的产量几乎是不分青红皂白的,而MiniCPM-o-4.5(Cui等,2026年)甚至很少出现真正的中断,揭示出总的准确性所掩盖的相反的失败. 补充性真实言论评价还表明,在天然的多党派会议上,中断探测仍然具有挑战性。 这些调查结果将选择性的中断处理确定为对多方全方位互动的长期限制。 我们的主要贡献是: 多党Turn Bench, 由240个多党对话组成的控制基准,涉及2至5个发言者和6个互动类型,并附有确切的事件状态说明,用于结束和中断探测。 系统评价跨声学、语义学和转子投影系统的地层-过渡探测,揭示出EOT-INT能力差距和对演讲者和对话风格的特有模式敏感性。 • 在五个全方位语音代理中进行端到端验证,暴露出尽管有强烈的转弯性能但几乎有选择地产生的结果,同时有不分青红皂白地屈服或无视真正中断的对立倾向。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Conversational floor management involves turn transitions, interruptions, backchannels, and competing speaker claims ( Sacks et al., 1974 ; Duncan, 1972 ; Yngve, 1970 ) . Talking Turns ( Arora et al., 2025a ) evaluates turn-taking in audio foundation models, while TurnBench ( Jiang and others, 2026 ) established causal EOT and interruption detection in dyadic conversational styles. SID-Bench ( Xia et al., 2026 ) further studies semantic interruption detection against non-interruptive backchannels. Table 1 shows that MultiPartyTurnBench addresses the complementary multi-party setting , where several listeners may produce overlapping, non-floor-taking speech and successful floor acquisition must be distinguished from competing vocal activity under a common event-level evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 对话楼层管理涉及转向过渡、中断、后通道和相互竞争的演讲者主张(Sacks等人,1974年;Duncan,1972年;Yngve,1970年)。 Talking Turns(Arora等,2025a)在音频基础模型中评价转接,而Turn Bench(Jiang等,2026)在dyadic对话风格中建立了因果EOT和中断检测. SID-Bench (Xia等, 2026) 进一步研究对非干扰后道的语义中断检测. 表1显示,多方Turn Bench涉及互补的多方设置,其中几个听众可能会产生重叠的、不带地板的演讲并成功获得楼层必须区别于共同事件级评价协议下的竞争声响活动。

blocks.en: Natural multi-speaker corpora support complementary prediction tasks. TEIDAN ( Triadic-VAP, 2025 ) evaluates future speaker activity in triadic Japanese conversations. AVCC ( Qi and Skantze, 2026 ) evaluates shift/hold and next-speaker prediction in audiovisual dialogue. VoxConverse ( Chung et al., 2020 ) studies floor-shift detection, boundary timing, and next-speaker identification ( Fast When, Careful Who, 2026 ) . These resources capture natural conversational dynamics, but do not score end-of-turn and interruption detection.
blocks.zh: 自然多语种corpora支持互补的预测任务. TEIDAN(Triadic-VAP,2025年)在三相日本对话中评价了未来的演讲者活动. AVCC(Qi和Skantze,2026年)在视听对话中评价转会/挂接和接班人预测. Vox 旋转 (Chung等,2020年) 研究地勤检测,边界计时,下行语音识别("快时","小心谁",2026年. 这些资源捕捉出自然对话动态,但不会得分倒转和中断检测.

blocks.en:
Full-Duplex-Bench series ( Lin and others, 2025 ; Lin and others, 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026b ) and FD-Bench ( Peng et al., 2025 ) evaluate real-time conversational behavior. Recent multi-party benchmarks broaden this scope in multi-party settings: Duplex-MPE ( Ma et al., 2026 ) assesses if agents respond, remain silent, or stop speaking in group conversations; MultiTalkBench ( Wang et al., 2026 ) examines long-form multi-party dialogue, and MSI-Bench ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) evaluates speaker-grounded
memory, instruction following, and reasoning. These benchmarks primarily assess conversational outcomes rather than standalone floor-event predictions. MultiPartyTurnBench isolates the underlying floor-discrimination problem , while separately validating how these distinctions manifest in full-duplex agent behavior.
blocks.zh:
Full-Duplex-Bench系列(Lin等,2025;Lin等,2026;Lin等,2026b)和FD-Bench(Peng等,2025)评价实时对话行为. 近期的多党基准在多党环境下扩大了这一范围:Duplex-MPE(Ma等,2026年)评估代理人是否回应,保持沉默,或停止在集体对话中发言;MultiTalk Bench(Wang等,2026年)审查长式多党对话;MSI-Bench(Xiong等,2026年)评价有演讲基础.
记忆 指令跟随 推理 这些基准主要评估对话结果,而不是独立的下层活动预测。 多方Turn Bench将潜在的底片歧视问题隔离开来,同时分别验证这些区别如何表现在完全复杂的代理行为上.

blocks.en: MultiPartyTurnBench evaluates whether systems can causally infer changes in conversational floor ownership from ongoing multi-speaker audio. It defines two complementary, event-conditioned tasks: (i) End-of-Turn (EOT) asks whether the current speaker has relinquished the floor and aims to detect genuine floor relinquishment by the current speaker, anchored at speech offset against hard negatives such as mid-turn pauses where the speaker retains the floor. (ii) Interruption (INT) asks whether another speaker has successfully acquired the floor and detects successful floor acquisition by another speaker, anchored at the interrupting speech onset, against hard negatives like backchannels and non-content vocalizations that leave floor ownership unchanged. Unsuccessful interruption attempts are excluded because their outcomes may only become apparent through subsequent interaction, making them ambiguous at onset for a causal detector ( Jiang and others, 2026 ) . Together, the two tracks evaluate floor relinquishment and acquisition against behaviorally confusable non-events, rather than speech activity alone (Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 多方Turn Bench评价系统是否能够从正在进行的多语种音频中因果地推断对话地板所有权的变化. 它界定了两项相辅相成的、符合事件条件的任务:(一) 结束发言(EOT)询问现任发言者是否放弃了发言,目的是发现现任发言者真正放弃发言,其基础是发言与硬反面(如在发言者保留发言时间时的中场休息)相抵消。 (二) 干扰(INT)问,另一名发言者是否成功地获得地板,并发现另一名发言者在中断发言时成功地获得地板,而反对硬底片,如后通道和非内容声波,使地板所有权保持不变。 未成功的中断尝试被排除在外,因为其结果可能只能通过后续的相互作用而变得明显,使得它们对于因果探测器在起动时模棱两可(Jiang等,2026). 这两条轨道共同评价地板放弃和获取与行为不相容的无关事件,而不是单凭言论活动(表2)。

blocks.en: 3.1 Benchmark Construction
blocks.zh: 3.1 基准建设

blocks.en: MPTB is designed to isolate floor-control decisions under independently controlled interaction conditions with exact event boundaries. In natural multi-party recordings, speaker count, overlap, listener activity, and acoustics vary jointly, complicating controlled analysis. We construct each conversation from an explicit floor-state representation before rendering speech in three steps: (1) define the event taxonomy for floor ownership changes; (2) select the interaction conditions and dialogue scripts; (3) staged generation pipeline renders synchronized multi-speaker audio recordings.
blocks.zh: MPTB的目的是在独立控制的相互作用条件下,用精确的事件边界来隔离地表控制决定. 在自然多党的录音中,扬声器计数,重叠,听众活动,和相声各有不同,使受控分析复杂化. 我们从明确的地层状态代表构建出每次对话,然后在演讲前分出三个步骤:(1) 定义事件分类,以改变地层所有权;(2) 选择交互条件和对话脚本;(3) 相接的生成管道使多语种同步录音.

blocks.en: Each event is defined relative to the current floor holder and whether floor ownership is retained, relinquished, or transferred. Five event types capture these transitions: Turn represents speech by the floor holder, resolved as hold , yield , or interrupted ; Interruption denotes a successful listener floor claim, while Non-Floor-Taking Interruption denotes an unsuccessful attempt. Backchannel captures listener speech without claiming the floor, and Noncontent captures non-linguistic activity without changing floor ownership. Table 2 maps these events to the EOT and INT evaluation targets.
blocks.zh: 每项活动的定义是相对于目前的地板持有者,以及是否保留、放弃或转让地板所有权。 五个事件类型捕捉这些过渡: Turn代表楼层持有者的发言,以搁置、屈服或中断方式解决; 中断表示听众楼层索赔成功,而Non-Floor-Takes Interruption表示尝试失败。 后道会捕捉听众的演讲而不要求地板,而非内容会捕捉非语言活动而不改变地板所有权. 表2将这些活动映射到EOT和INT的评价目标上。

blocks.en: MPTB crosses speaker count ( N ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } N\in\{2,3,4,5\} ) with six interaction types derived from TurnBench ( Jiang and others, 2026 ) : Casual, Task-Oriented, Instructional, Collaborative, Argumentative, and Narrative. These regimes elicit distinct turn-taking dynamics while enabling controlled comparisons across group sizes at fixed interaction style, and vice versa. Generation additionally controls backchannel and interruption occurrences, while acoustic rendering varies ambient noise and nuisance events. See Appendix C.2 for definitions of each interaction type.
blocks.zh: MPTB会交叉扬声器计数(N {{2,3,4,5}N\in}2,3,4,5}),由Turn Bench(Jiang等,2026年)衍生出6个交互类型: Casual, Task-Oriented, Directoral, Cooperation, Conference, Conference, Conference, Conference, Conference, Conference, C. 这些制度产生不同的交接动态,同时能够以固定的相互作用方式对群体大小进行有控制的比较,反之亦然。 生成还额外控制了后道和中断事件,而声波渲染则不同环境噪音和扰动事件. 每种相互作用类型的定义见附录C.2。

blocks.en: Figure 2 illustrates the five-stage pipeline for multi-speaker acoustic realization annotated with conversational floor dynamics. The first two stages establish the canonical event log and interaction timeline before speech synthesis, ensuring that ground-truth labels derive from the underlying floor state rather than retrospective waveform analysis.
blocks.zh: 图2显示多语种声学实现的五阶段管道,附有对话地板动态说明。 前两个阶段在语音合成前建立犬类事件日志和交互时间线,确保地表真实标签取自基础地层状态,而不是回溯波形分析.

blocks.en: 1. Event-conditioned dialogue generation. Off-the-shelf LLM like GPT-4.1 generates multi-party scripts conditioned on speaker count, interaction type, topic, narrative plot, and target turn-taking statistics. A restricted event vocabulary ( TURN , CLAIM_FLOOR , VOCALIZE_NO_CLAIM ) specifies conversational actions, with backchannel and interruption frequencies guided by TurnBench ( Jiang and others, 2026 ) . The LLM determines linguistic content and proposes listener actions but does not assign final timestamps or resolve floor ownership. Scripts are schema-validated, with malformed outputs regenerated or rejected.
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 事件有条件的对话生成。 像GPT-4.1那样的现成LLM生成多党脚本,其条件为演讲者计数,互动类型,话题,叙事情节,以及目标取转统计. 限制活动词汇(TURN, Claim-FLOOR, VOCALIZE_NO-CLAIM)指定了对话动作,由Turn Bench(Jiang等,2026年)指导回道和中断频率. LLM决定了语言内容,并提出了听众动作,但没有指定最终的时间戳或解决地板所有权. 脚本有计划验证,错误的输出会被再生成或拒绝.

blocks.en: 2. Floor-state orchestration. A discrete-event orchestrator maintains the current floor holder and resolves symbolic actions into realized transitions: TURN becomes a hold, yield, or interruption-forced termination; CLAIM_FLOOR resolves either to a successful Interruption or a Non-Floor-Taking Interruption ; and VOCALIZE_NO_CLAIM produces a backchannel or related non-floor-changing event. The orchestrator assigns turn durations, inter-speaker gaps, pauses, and interruption overlap based on real-world timing statistics from AMI corpus ( Carletta and others, 2006 ) . Explicit mid-turn pauses provide EOT hard negatives. The resulting placement schedule and canonical event log define exact EOT and INT anchors.
blocks.zh: 2. 联合国 楼下州管弦乐团. 独立活动管弦乐手负责维护目前的地板,并解决向已实现过渡的象征性行动: TURN成为搁置、屈服或中断的强制终止; 索赔_FLOOR解决了成功的中断或非FLOOR中断; VOCALIZE_NO_CLAIM产生回通道或相关的非地板变化事件。 管弦乐团根据AMI accorporation(Carletta等,2006年)的实时计时统计,分配转接时间、发言间隔、暂停和中断重叠。 明确的中转暂停提供EOT硬底片. 由此产生的放置时间表和犬科事件日志定义了准确的EOT和INT锚地.

blocks.en: 3. Speaker rendering. Utterances are independently synthesized using Kokoro-82M ( hexgrad, 2024 ) , with distinct voices sampled from a gender-balanced pool of 24 voices, preventing voice reuse within a conversation. Development and test splits use disjoint voice inventories (8 and 16 voices, respectively). Word-level timing is retained for alignment and quality control.
blocks.zh: 3个 扬声器渲染。 Utterances是使用Kokoro-82M(hexgrad,2024)独立合成的,从一个性别平衡的24个声音池中抽取出不同的声音,防止了声音在对话中被重复使用. 开发与测试分拆使用脱节语音盘(分别为8个和16个). 保留文字级别的时间,以进行校正和质量控制。

blocks.en: 4. Acoustic scene rendering. Synthesized speech is placed on synchronized speaker channels according to the orchestrated timeline, preserving overlap determined by floor-state transitions. Successful interruptions end with a short fade applied at the truncation boundary, and channels are peak-normalized independently. A shared voice-free ambient bed (filtered pink noise and humming) is mixed at a per-conversation SNR. MUSAN ( Snyder et al., 2015 ) sound effects and intermittent distant third-party speech introduces nuisance activity to stress false-positive detection; neither creates benchmark-positive floor events.
blocks.zh: 4.四. 音响场景渲染. 合成演讲按照精心安排的时间表放入同步的扬声道,保留由地层状态过渡确定的重叠. 成功的中断会以在分叉边界上应用的短暂的淡出而结束,而通道会独立地被峰值正常化. 一个共享的无声环境床(被过滤的粉红色噪音和蜂鸣)被混合到每个对口的SNR. MUSAN(Snyder等,2015年)音效和间歇性远程第三方言论引入了骚扰活性来强调假阳性检测;既不产生基准正底事件.

blocks.en: 5. Channel assembly and release artifacts. Each conversation is released with its noisy evaluation channels, clean reference channels, tagged script, canonical event log, render metadata, and generation seed. Clean channels are retained for quality control, while benchmark systems operate on the noisy rendition. All non-generative stages are deterministic with recorded seeds and manifests, enabling exact reproduction of the interaction schedule and acoustic assembly (see Appendix C.3 ).
blocks.zh: 5 (韩语). 海峡装配并放出文物. 每一次对话都会用其吵闹的评价渠道,干净的参考渠道,被标记的脚本,犬科事件日志,渲染出元数据,以及生成种子. 为质量控制保留了清洁通道,而基准系统则在高音移出时运行。 所有非遗传阶段都具有确定性,有记录的种子和出品,从而能够准确复制相互作用表和声学组装(见附录C.3)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Benchmark Composition
blocks.zh: 3.2 基准构成

blocks.en: MPTB contains 240 conversations (6.89 hours), balanced across four speaker-count settings ( N ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } N\in\{2,3,4,5\} ) crossed with the six interaction types. It contains 48 development and 192 test conversations using disjoint speaker voices. The corpus contains 3,422 EOT positives and 241 hold negatives, alongside 367 INT positives and 1,481 non-floor-taking negatives. MPTB closely mimic natural turn-taking distributions. See Appendix D for event-interaction trends. We additionally validate the generated floor events through independent human annotations in Appendix A ).
blocks.zh: MPTB包含240个对话(6.89小时),平衡了四个演讲者计数设置(N {{2,3,4,5}N\in}2,3,4,5}),与6个交互类型相交叉. 它包含48个开发,192个测试对话,使用脱节的演说者声音. 病历包括3 422个EOT阳性,241个持有阴性,还有367个INT阳性,1 481个非底取阴性。 MPTB紧密地模仿了自然取转的分布. 见附录 D指事件互动趋势。 我们通过附录A中独立的人文说明,进一步验证产生的会场事件。

blocks.en: 4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 评价

blocks.en: Figure 3: MultiPartyTurnBench evaluation protocol. Causal per-speaker predictions are matched to reference events and scored against hard-negative spans. Development-selected thresholds are frozen for test evaluation, with performance measured through recall, false-positive rate, and latency.
blocks.zh: 图3:多缔约方的Bench评价协议。 对每个说话者的因果预测与参考事件相匹配,并对照硬阴性横跨而得分. 开发选定的阈值被冻结用于测试评价,通过召回、假阳性率和耐久性衡量业绩。

blocks.en: Figure 3 illustrates the causal evaluation protocol: systems emit timestamped EOT and INT decisions using only audio observed up to prediction time. We evaluate event recall, false-positive rate, and signed decision latency at fixed operating points.
blocks.zh: 图3说明了因果评价协议:系统只使用观测到的音频到预测时间就发出印有时间戳的EOT和INT决定。 我们评估事件召回率、假阳性率,并在固定作业点签署决定。

blocks.en: Prediction and Event Matching. Per-speaker model scores are converted to discrete events through threshold crossings with a 2 s refractory period. Following TurnBench ( Jiang and others, 2026 ) , each gold positive at t i t_{i} is matched one-to-one to the earliest unmatched prediction within [ t i − 0.25 , t i + 3.0 ] [t_{i}-0.25,\;t_{i}+3.0] s. Matched events are true positives (TP), while unmatched gold positives are false negatives (FN). Hard negatives are scored as temporal spans: any detection within a span counts as a false positive (FP), otherwise a true negative (TN). Predictions outside scored regions are ignored.
blocks.zh: 预测和事件匹配。 人语模型分数通过2个折叠期的阈值交叉转换为离散事件. 继Turn Bench(Jiang等,2026年)后,每个黄金正值为t i t_{i}在 [t i − 0.25,t i + 3.0] [t_{i]-0.25,\;t_{i}+ → 3.0] 内部的一对一对应最早期的无比预测. s. 相匹配的事件为真阳性(TP),而无相匹配的金正性为假阴性(FN). 硬底片被打成时间跨度:一个跨度内的任何检测都算作假正(FP),否则算作正(TN). 记分区以外的预测被忽略.

Systems exceeding FPR test > 0.15 \mathrm{FPR}_{\mathrm{test}}>0.15 are marked out-of-budget. We report Recall = TP / ( TP + FN ) \mathrm{Recall}=\mathrm{TP}/(\mathrm{TP}+\mathrm{FN}) and FPR = FP / ( FP + TN ) \mathrm{FPR}=\mathrm{FP}/(\mathrm{FP}+\mathrm{TN}) , alongside signed latency Δ ​ t i = t i pred − t i gold \Delta t_{i}=t_{i}^{\mathrm{pred}}-t_{i}^{\mathrm{gold}} (p10/p50/p90), where + + ve / − - ve values indicate delayed / early commitments.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments
blocks.zh: 5个实验

blocks.en: Offline EOT and INT Evaluation. We evaluate 12 systems across three families: acoustic VAD (RMS Energy, WebRTC VAD ( Google WebRTC Project, ) , Silero VAD ( Silero Team, 2024 ) ); semantic endpointers (Smart Turn v2 ( Pipecat AI, 2025 ) , Kyutai SVAD ( Kyutai, ) , Mimi Endpointer ( Udupa et al., 2025 ) ); and turn-taking models (VAP ( Ekstedt and Skantze, 2022 ) , MuVAP ( Qi and Skantze, 2026 ) , DualTurn ( Rajaa, 2026 ) , WavLM-Large anchor ( Chen et al., 2022 ) , Turn-1-Mini ( p99lab, 2026 ) , ESPnet Turn-Taking ( Arora et al., 2025b ) ). VAP is adapted to multi-party audio through speaker-versus-rest inference. We report EOT and INT performance across speaker-count and interaction-type breakdowns using development-selected operating points. See Appendix E.1 and F.4 for model configurations and score mappings.
blocks.zh: 离线EOT和INT评价. 我们评价了三个家庭的12个系统:声波VAD(RMS Energy, WebRTC VAD (Google WebRTC Project,),Silero VAD (Silero Team, 2024));语义端点. VAP通过扬声器对收音机的推论来适应多方音频. 我们利用开发选定的操作点,报告EOT和INT在发言计数和互动类型的分解方面的表现。 关于模型配置和分数绘图,见附录E.1和F.4。

blocks.en: Full Duplex Agent Evaluation. We test five full-duplex voice agents— GPT-Live-1 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Gemini-3.8-Live ( Google, 2026 ) , MiniCPM-o-4.5 ( Cui et al., 2026 ) , Realtime-Venus ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) , and Step-Audio3-Realtime ( Lin et al., 2026a ) —on 120 interactive floor-control scenarios, repeated three times per system. These experiments distinguish offline event detection from agents’ observable decisions to enter or relinquish the conversational floor. See Appendix E for scoring configurations.

blocks.en: RQ1: Can Models Reliably Identify Floor Transitions?
blocks.zh: RQ1:罐型号 可靠地识别地平线过渡?

blocks.en: Turn completion is comparatively tractable; successful floor acquisition is not. Table 3 reveals a pronounced asymmetry between the two floor-control decisions. VAP and Kyutai SVAD achieve comparable EOT recall (92.6% and 92.5%) at low FPR (7.5% and 4.3%), yet recover only 11.7% and 56.2% of successful interruptions, respectively. Even the strongest qualified INT detector misses nearly half of genuine takeovers. Thus, recognizing when a speaker has finished does not translate into determining whether incoming speech has actually displaced the current floor holder.
blocks.zh: 转弯的完成是相对可行的;成功取得楼层不是。 表3显示两个楼层控制决定之间明显不对称。 VAP和Kyutai SVAD在低水平的FPR(7.5%和4.3%)中实现了类似的EOT召回(92.6%和92.5%),但分别只恢复了11.7%和56.2%。 连最强的INT检测器 都错过了近一半真正的收购 因此,承认发言者发言完毕后,并不等于确定即将到来的发言是否实际上使现任楼层持有人流离失所。

blocks.en: High recall without selectivity is insufficient for conversational control. Acoustic detectors illustrate why floor transitions cannot be reduced to speech activity. Silero VAD achieves 97.2% EOT and 85.4% INT recall, but incurs prohibitive FPRs of 93.5% and 89.2%. Semantic and turn-taking models suppress these false activations, often at the cost of missed takeovers: Mimi Endpointer achieves 90.5% EOT recall but detects only 13.9% of interruptions. This exposes the central challenge: distinguishing genuine floor claims from listener activity that leaves floor ownership unchanged.
blocks.zh: 没有选择性的高额召回不足以控制对话。 声波探测器说明了为什么地板过渡不能降低为语音活性. Silero VAD实现了97.2%的EOT和85.4%的INT召回,但出现了93.5%和89.2%的令人望而却步的FPR. 语义学和取回模式压制了这些虚假的活化,往往以错过收购为代价: Mimi Endpointer实现90.5%的EOT召回,但检测到中断的只有13.9%. 这暴露了中心挑战:区分真正的楼层要求和听者活动,使楼层所有权保持不变。

blocks.en: Detection quality and latency trade-offs. Even among strong EOT detectors, comparable recall conceals substantial timing differences. VAP detects turn endings at 143 ms p50, versus 1,829 ms for Kyutai SVAD, despite nearly identical recall. Thus, a correct floor transition detected too late may still disrupt natural interaction.
blocks.zh: 发现质量和延迟的取舍。 即使在强大的电子机会测试探测器中,类似的召回也掩盖了时间的巨大差异。 VAP探测到端口为143 mss p50,而Kyutai SVAD的端口为1,829 ms,尽管几乎同样被召回. 因此,检测到的正确地面过渡为时过晚,仍会破坏自然相互作用。

blocks.en: RQ2: Does Speaker Count Make Floor Control Harder?
blocks.zh: RQ2:议长是否计算出更硬的地板控制?

blocks.en: More speakers do not produce uniform degradation in EOT detection. Figure 4 shows that EOT detection remains comparatively stable across two to five speakers. VAP maintains 92–93% recall, while MuVAP and DualTurn show similarly small variations. Surprisingly, Kyutai improves from 84.6% to 96.6%, suggesting that increasing speaker count does not inherently make turn completion harder under MPTB’s controlled conditions.
blocks.zh: 在EOT检测中,更多发言者不会产生统一的降解. 图4显示,在2至5名发言者中,EOT检测相对稳定。 VAP保持92–93%的回想率,而MuVAP和DualTurn则显示出类似的小变化. 令人惊讶的是,京泰从84.6%升至96.6%,这表明在MPTB控制的条件下,增加的扬声器计数本身不会使完成工作更加困难。

blocks.en:
Interruption detection exhibits opposing speaker-count trends. Kyutai’s INT recall declines from 63.3% to 48.7% as speaker count increases from two to five, whereas MuVAP improves from 23.3% to 40.8%, with DualTurn showing a similar upward trend. Yet no model exceeds 50% INT recall at five speakers. These opposing trajectories suggest that models exploit multi-speaker context differently when interpreting competing floor claims. Relational speaker modeling may offer advantages over channel-local endpointing. Speaker count therefore exposes model-specific vulnerabilities rather than a universal scaling penalty.
See Appendix F.3 for recall–FPR breakdowns across speaker counts.
blocks.zh:
中断检测显示,发言者人数趋势相反。 Kyutai的INT召回率从63.3%下降到48.7%,因为演讲者人数从2人增加到5人,而MuVAP则从23.3%增加到40.8%,DualTurn也呈现出类似的上升趋势。 然而,在5名发言者中,没有任何模式超过50%的INT召回率。 这些对立的轨迹表明,模型在解释相竞争的楼层索赔时不同地利用了多语种上下文. 相关扬声器的建模可能比频道-本地端点具有优势。 因此,议长计数暴露了模式特有的弱点,而不是普遍适用的衡量惩罚。

blocks.en: RQ3: Which Interaction Types Expose Failures?
blocks.zh: RQ3: 哪些相互作用类型出现失败?

blocks.en: Interruption detection is substantially more sensitive to interaction style. Figure 5 (and Appendix F.2 ) shows that EOT detection remains comparatively stable across interaction types with limited variation. In contrast, INT recall shows large swings under the same threshold (Kyutai SVAD is 47.0% in collaborative dialogue to 77.5% in instructional exchanges). This disparity suggests that EOT detection generalizes more consistently across interaction regimes compared to INT detection.
blocks.zh: 中断检测对交互风格的敏感度要高得多. 图5(和附录F.2)显示,EOT检测在相互作用类型之间相对稳定,变化有限。 相比之下,INT召回显示在同一阈值下出现大回旋(Kyutai SVAD在协作对话中为47.0%,在教学交流中为77.5%). 这种差异表明,与INT检测相比,EOT检测在各种相互作用制度中的通用程度更为一致。

blocks.en: Conversational difficulty is model-dependent. Kyutai struggles most with collaborative exchanges, while MuVAP performs worst on narrative dialogue (25.0% INT recall), DualTurn on task-oriented interactions (32.6%), and VAP and Mimi Endpointer on argumentative exchanges. These contrasting failures suggest that models rely on different conversational cues when interpreting floor claims, rather than a shared hierarchy of interaction difficulty. See Appendix I for qualitative examples.
blocks.zh: 对话难度取决于模型. MUVAP在叙事对话方面表现最差(25.0%的INT召回),在任务导向互动方面表现最差(32.6%),在辩论交流方面表现最差(VAP和Mimi Endpointer)。 这些相形见绌的失败表明模型在解释地板索赔时依赖于不同的对话提示,而不是共同的交互难度等级. 见附录 我指的是定性的例子。

blocks.en: RQ4: Can Voice Agents Yield Selectively?
blocks.zh: RQ4:语音代理可以选择吗?

blocks.en: Table 4 extends offline detection to observable behavior in five full-duplex agents. Four systems achieve 86.1–95.8% START balanced accuracy, reliably distinguishing genuine turn endings from mid-turn holds. Yet this competence collapses when deciding whether to yield: all five achieve only 46.9–54.7% STOP balanced accuracy, with confidence intervals including chance performance. The offline EOT–INT asymmetry thus manifests directly in agent behavior: models recognize end of turn but struggle to determine when incoming speech interruptions.
blocks.zh: 表4将线下检测扩展至5个全复方位剂的可观测行为. 四个系统实现了86.1%-95.8%的裁武会谈平衡准确性,可靠地区分了中转期的真正转折。 然而,在决定是否屈服时,这种能力就会崩溃: 所有5个国家都只实现了46.9%-54.7%的平衡准确性,信任间隔包括机会性能。 因此,离线EOT-INT的不对称直接表现在代理行为中:模型识别出转折的结束,但艰难地决定了即将到来的语音中断时间.

blocks.en: Gemini-3.8-Live effectively surrendering the floor indiscriminately (97.7% of backchannels, bias + 0.98 +0.98 ). Conversely, MiniCPM-o-4.5 almost never yields, ignoring 98.6% of genuine interruptions (bias − 0.99 -0.99 ). Realtime-Venus similarly resists yielding, while GPT-Live-1 is more balanced but remains unreliable. These opposing behaviors suggest inability of the voice agents to distinguish the conversational significance of incoming audio (see Appendix G ).
blocks.zh: 双子座-3.8- 有效放弃地平线不分青红皂白(97.7%的后道,偏差+0.98+0.98),反之,MiniCPM-o-4.5几乎从未出产,忽略了98.6%的真正中断(bias-0.99-0.99). 实时-维纳斯同样抵制出产,而GPT-Live-1则较为平衡,但仍不可靠. 这些对立的行为表明语音代理无法区分所传入音频的谈话意义(见附录G.

blocks.en: 7 Discussion
blocks.zh: 7 讨论情况

blocks.en: Multi-party floor control requires reasoning about speaker roles, not merely speech activity. MPTB exposes a fundamental limitation of conventional endpointing: incoming speech does not necessarily imply a change in floor ownership. Reliable interruption handling in multi-speaker settings requires distinguishing competing floor claims from backchannels and other non-floor-taking activity, conditioned on the current speaker and conversational context. This motivates event-conditioned modeling of floor transitions rather than independent speech-activity decisions.
blocks.zh: 多党楼层控制要求推理演说角色,而不仅仅是演讲活动. MPTB揭露了传统端点的根本限制:即将到来的演讲并不一定意味着地板所有权的改变. 要在多语种环境中进行可靠的中断处理,就必须将相互竞争的楼层索赔与后通道和其他非楼层取暖活动区分开来,并以当前演讲者和对话背景为条件。 这推动了以事件为条件的平面过渡模型,而不是独立的言论活动决定。

blocks.en: Floor-control evaluation must capture the consequences of incorrect decisions. High event recall can conceal excessive false activations, while conservative yielding policies can appear reliable despite missing genuine interruptions. MPTB demonstrates the importance of evaluation breakdowns across speaker counts and interaction regimes. Such diagnostics expose failure modes obscured by aggregate scores and provide actionable targets for developing more selective full-duplex systems.
blocks.zh: 控制最低标准评价必须反映错误决定的后果。 高事件召回可以掩盖过度的虚假活化,而保守的屈服政策则可以看起来可靠,尽管没有出现真正的中断。 MPTB显示了按发言者计数和互动制度进行分类评价的重要性。 这种诊断暴露出被总分所掩盖的失败模式,为发展更具选择性的全复式系统提供了可操作的目标。

blocks.en: Synthetic to real evaluation gap. Table 24 illustrates that this difficulty is not confined to synthetic speech: VAP recovers only 35.9% of interruptions on real four-party AMI meetings at 5.3% FPR, despite in-slice threshold tuning. This supports corroborating learnings from synthetic evaluations to real-world relevance of the interruption challenge.
blocks.zh: 合成为真正的评价差距. 表24表明,这种困难并不局限于合成语言:尽管切入阈值调谐,但VAP在实际的四方AMI会议中只恢复了35.9%的中断. 这有助于证实从综合评价到现实世界对中断挑战的关联性。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We introduced MultiPartyTurnBench , a controlled benchmark for turn taking dynamics for end-of-turn and interruption detection in multi-party spoken dialogues. Existing systems detect turn completion reliably but struggle to recognize floor takeovers without excessive false activations, with failures varying across conversational regimes and speaker counts. This asymmetry extends to full-duplex agents where all systems perform near chance on selective yielding. MultiPartyTurnBench establishes selective interruption handling as a critical unresolved challenge for reliable multi-party voice interaction.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了多党Turn Bench,这是在多党口语对话中采取动态和发现中断的可控基准。 现有系统能可靠地检测完成情况,但难以识别没有过度虚假激活的楼层接管,各种对话制度和演讲者计数的失败各不相同。 这种不对称现象延伸到所有系统在有选择地屈服时几乎都有机会发挥作用的全相混合剂。 多党Turn Bench将选择性的中断处理确定为可靠的多党语音互动的关键未解决挑战.

blocks.en: 9 Limitations
blocks.zh: 9 限制

blocks.en: Synthetic speech and external validity. MPTB’s controlled construction provides exact floor-state annotations and reproducible interaction conditions, but synthesized speech cannot fully capture the prosody, disfluencies, timing adaptations, and ambiguous floor negotiations of spontaneous conversation. The synthetic-to-real comparison (Table 24 ) reveals non-uniform difficulty: learned endpointers generally achieve higher EOT recall on MPTB, whereas VAP detects fewer interruptions on MPTB (11.7%) than on real four-party AMI (35.9%). Thus, synthetic evaluation does not uniformly overestimate performance, and MPTB scores should be interpreted as controlled diagnostics rather than estimates of natural-conversation error rates.
blocks.zh: 合成口语与外道有效性. MPTB控制的构造提供了精确的地层状态说明和可再生的交互条件,但合成的语音无法完全捕捉出自发对话的发音,不流畅,时间调整和模棱两可的地层谈判. 合成-实相比较(表24)揭示出非统一性困难:学习到的端点在MPTB上一般能实现更高的EOT召回,而VAP在MPTB上检测到的中断次数(11.7%)比实际的四方AMI(35.9%)要少. 因此,合成评价并不统一高估性能,MPTB分数应被解释为有控制的诊断,而不应被解释为对自然相通误差率的估计.

blocks.en: Scope of real-speech validation. Our multi-party validation uses 15 four-speaker AMI meetings with floor events derived from manual speech segments rather than independently annotated under the MPTB taxonomy. The evaluated corpora also differ in speaker count, conversational domain, acoustics, annotation protocols, and threshold calibration, with real-audio slices using in-slice tuning. Cross-corpus differences therefore cannot be attributed causally to speaker count or synthetic speech. AMI provides complementary evidence that interruption detection remains challenging in natural multi-party conversation, but does not establish direct synthetic-to-real performance transfer.
blocks.zh: 实相语音鉴定范围. 我们的多党验证使用15个四语的AMI会议,会场活动来自人工演讲部分,而不是在MPTB分类法下独立注释. 被评价的Corpora在扬声器计数,对话域,声学,注释协议,和阈值校正等方面也有差异,而真声片则使用切片入声调. 因此,不能将公司之间的差别归结为演讲者计数或合成言论。 AMI提供了补充证据,说明中断探测在自然多党对话中仍然具有挑战性,但并没有建立直接合成到实际的性能转移.

blocks.en: Linguistic and demographic coverage. MPTB is restricted to English, with accent diversity limited to the voices sampled during synthesis rather than representative real-world speaker populations. We do not systematically evaluate generalization across languages, regional accents, or speaker demographics. Turn-taking conventions, prosodic cues, and interruption behaviors may vary across linguistic and sociocultural contexts. Consequently, our findings should not be interpreted as universal patterns of conversational floor control; broader multilingual and demographically diverse real-speech evaluation is necessary to establish their generality.
blocks.zh: 语言和人口覆盖率。 MPTB仅限于英语,口音多样性仅限于合成过程中所抽样的声音,而不是具有代表性的真人世界语族. 我们没有系统地评价各种语言、区域口音或演讲人口统计学的通俗化。 采取转接方式的习俗、道具和中断行为可能因语言和社会文化背景而异。 因此,我们的调查结果不应被解释为对话控制底板的普遍模式;为了确定其普遍性,有必要进行更广泛的多语种和人口多样性的真话评价。

blocks.en: Ethics Statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: The released MPTB corpus contains synthetic speech and fictional LLM-generated dialogue rather than newly collected private conversations. The benchmark is designed to diagnose conversational control failures and should not be interpreted as a safety certification for deployment. Real TurnBench material used for scorer validation is not redistributed, and AMI is used under its existing research terms. Because full-duplex systems may be used in multi-user or high-stakes settings, benchmark performance should be considered alongside broader evaluations of recognition quality, safety, fairness, privacy, and task correctness.
blocks.zh: 发行的"MPTB"(MPTB acident)包含合成语音和虚构LLM生成的对话,而不是新收集的私人对话. 该基准旨在诊断对话控制故障,不应被解释为部署的安全证明。 用于计分器验证的Real Turn Bench 材料不重新分配,在其现有的研究术语下使用AMI. 由于全双系统可能用于多用户或高购环境,因此在对识别质量、安全、公平、隐私和任务正确性进行更广泛的评价的同时,还应考虑基准业绩。

blocks.en: Appendix A Human Evaluation Study
blocks.zh: 附录A 人类评价研究

blocks.en: A.1 Human Annotation
blocks.zh: A.1 人类注释

blocks.en: Although MPTB derives floor-state labels before speech synthesis, a procedurally valid event may not be perceived as intended in the rendered audio. We therefore conduct a human validation study assessing whether listeners recognize the intended event categories and their temporal realization. The study covers all 240 conversations and 6,116 candidate events, with three independent annotations per event (18,348 primary categorical judgments, excluding blind repeats).
blocks.zh: 虽然MPTB在语音合成之前会获得地表状态的标签,但程序上有效的事件可能不会被视为所提供音频中的意图. 因此,我们开展了一项人类验证研究,评估听众是否承认预定活动类别及其时间实现。 该研究涵盖所有240个谈话和6,116个候选活动,每个活动有3个独立说明(18,348个主要的绝对判断,不包括盲目重复)。

blocks.en: Annotators have native or near-native English comprehension and complete written guidelines, worked audio examples, and a held-out calibration set emphasizing turn completion versus continuation, backchannels versus floor claims, and successful versus unsuccessful interruptions. Qualification requires at least 75% agreement with expert labels across 10 calibration examples. Annotators are blinded to generator labels, event logs, and model predictions.
blocks.zh: 注释者有本土或近本土的英语理解和完整的书面准则,有工作的声音实例,以及一套坚持的校正,强调转折完成与续作,回通道与地板索赔,成功与不成功的中断。 资格要求至少75%与10个校准实例的专家标签达成协议. 注释者对生成器标签,事件日志和模型预测视而不见.

blocks.en: Annotators inspect candidate regions with 10 s of preceding and following context using synchronized multi-speaker audio, independently controllable speaker channels, and a shared timeline. For each region, they assign an event category, identify the perceived floor holder before and after the event, and mark onset and offset timestamps. An ambiguous label is permitted when the floor outcome cannot be determined reliably. Automatic transcripts are available as references, but audio takes precedence. Table 5 summarizes the annotation fields.
blocks.zh: 注释者通过同步多语种音频、独立可控的演讲者频道和共享时间表,检查10 s 前后背景的候选区域。 对每个区域,它们都指定一个活动类别,在活动之前和之后确定所感知的地板持有者,并标记起动和抵消时间戳。 如果无法可靠地确定下限结果,则允许使用模棱两可的标签。 自动录音记录作为参考资料提供,但音频优先。 表5汇总了注释字段。

blocks.en: Annotations are collected independently without discussion or adjudication. Examples are presented in randomized order across interaction conditions, speaker counts, and voices. A subset of 25% of examples is repeated blindly to assess intra-annotator consistency. Since listeners receive subsequent conversational context, this study validates the perceptual realization of floor transitions rather than their causal predictability at event onset.
blocks.zh: 说明未经讨论或裁决单独收集。 实例按交互条件、发言者数和声音的随机顺序排列。 25%的例子被盲目重复,以评估通知人内部的一致性。 由于听众收到后续的对话语境,本研究验证了地平线过渡的感知实现,而不是其在事发时的因果关系.

blocks.en: Table 5: Human annotation schema. Annotators independently identify event categories, floor holders, and temporal boundaries using the role-relative taxonomy (Table 13 ). Noncontent corresponds to listener laughter in the released corpus.
blocks.zh: 表5:人类注释计划. 注释者使用角色相对分类法独立识别事件类别,地板持有者和时间界限(表13). 非内容对应于释放物中的听者笑声.

blocks.en: A.2 Consensus and Agreement Measures
blocks.zh: A.2 协商一致和协议措施

blocks.en: We construct human consensus independently of the generator event log. A candidate receives a majority-consensus label when at least two of three annotators assign the same event category. Candidates without categorical consensus are treated as unresolved for human-validation analysis. For agreed events, the consensus boundary is the median timestamp of the agreeing annotators.
blocks.zh: 我们构建人类共识 独立于生成器事件记录。 当3个注释者中至少有2个指定同一事件类别时,候选人获得多数共识标签。 没有绝对共识的候选人被视为尚未解决的人-验证分析。 对于商定的事件,协商一致的界限是同意的注释者的中位时间戳。

blocks.en: We distinguish three complementary measures. Categorical consensus is the fraction of candidate events receiving a majority label, while Fleiss’ κ \kappa measures inter-annotator categorical agreement corrected for chance. Boundary F1 measures temporal agreement using a 500 ms boundary tolerance. Finally, generator–human agreement measures whether the procedurally assigned event label matches the independent human consensus. Fleiss’ κ \kappa is calculated using a one-versus-rest measure over the complete corpus. Boundary F1 temporal agreement is calculated relative to consensus boundaries.

blocks.en: A.3 Human Validation Results
blocks.zh: A.3 人类验证结果

blocks.en: Table 6 reports agreement across the six generated event categories. Backchannels show the strongest consistency, with 93.6% categorical consensus, Fleiss’ κ = 0.92 \kappa=0.92 , and boundary F1 of 0.95. Successful interruptions exhibit lower consensus (81.4%) and temporal agreement (F1 = 0.89 =0.89 ), indicating greater uncertainty in identifying the realization and timing of floor takeovers. Turn endings and mid-turn holds also exhibit lower categorical consensus than backchannels, supporting the distinction between acoustic speech cessation and perceived floor relinquishment.

blocks.en: Among events receiving human consensus, generator–human agreement ranges from 86.5% for turn endings to 97.8% for backchannels. Successful interruptions achieve 91.2% generator–human agreement despite having the lowest categorical consensus (81.4%). These measures capture different properties: consensus reflects consistency across annotators, whereas generator–human agreement evaluates label correspondence only on retained events. High conditional agreement therefore supports the plausibility of recognized synthetic events but does not establish that every generated event is perceptually unambiguous.

blocks.en: Table 7 shows a consistent decline across all three agreement measures as the number of speakers increases. Categorical consensus falls from 87.8% at N = 2 N=2 to 80.1% at N = 5 N=5 , while Fleiss’ κ \kappa decreases from 0.84 to 0.76 and boundary F1 from 0.96 to 0.90. The simultaneous reduction in categorical and temporal agreement suggests that resolving floor transitions becomes less consistent across annotators in larger groups. This is a descriptive association rather than an isolated causal effect of speaker count, since realized event composition and acoustic conditions may also differ.

blocks.en: The human study provides complementary evidence that MPTB’s generated floor-state categories have recognizable acoustic and conversational realizations, while identifying residual ambiguity in floor transitions, particularly successful interruptions. Since candidate regions are selected from the generator event log and annotators may inspect future context, these findings validate event-label plausibility rather than independent event discovery or real-time detectability. The study also does not establish that synthetic speech captures the full variability of natural multi-party interaction.

blocks.en: Generation proceeds in five stages. (1) An LLM writes a role-tagged dialogue conditioned on party count, interaction type, and target rates for backchannels and interruptions. (2) A deterministic state machine resolves floor claims, holds, yields, and overlaps into a timed event graph. (3) Kokoro-82M renders each speaker using a disjoint voice pool. (4) A controlled noise stage adds procedural ambient sound, discrete non-content events, and intermittent distant speech. (5) The assembler emits synchronized per-speaker audio and the exact event log. Scripts, seeds, audio manifests, and scorer inputs are recorded for reproducibility. The remainder of this section specifies every stage.

blocks.en: Scripts are generated by gpt-4.1 (all 240 conversations) with the system prompt and user template of Figures 7 and 8 , temperature 0.9, a 8,000-token output limit and JSON output. Each utterance carries exactly one event type ( turn , claim_floor , vocalize_no_claim ), a qualitative timing hint and, where applicable, a target holder and a resolution hint. Outputs are validated against structural rules (first utterance is a turn ; claims and vocalizations require a current holder and target it; every speaker holds at least one turn ; at least max ⁡ ( 2 ​ N , 8 ) \max(2N,8) turns; closed tag and hint vocabularies). A failed validation is returned to the model with the error list for repair, up to three attempts with seeds seed + k \text{seed}+k . Before validation, any backchannel longer than three words is deterministically relabelled as a non-floor-taking claim, so that multi-word listener speech is never scored as an INT negative. Realized scripts contain 6,800 utterances (28.3 per conversation): 4,347 turn (median 16 words), 367 successful claims (median 9 words), 605 failed claims (median 5 words), 1,176 backchannels (median 1 word) and 305 laughter vocalizations (median 2 words).

blocks.en: Stage-1 system prompt, verbatim (1/2): output schema You are a meticulous dialogue data generator that writes REALISTIC multi-party spoken conversation transcripts for a turn-taking benchmark. You output STRICT JSON only. The transcript is an ordered list of utterances. Each utterance is one JSON object with these fields: - "speaker": one of the given speaker ids (e.g. "speaker_1"). - "text": what is actually said aloud. Natural spoken English (disfluencies, "um", "like", trailing "---" for cut-offs are welcome). No stage directions, no narration, no lists/bullets. - "event_type": exactly one of: - "TURN": a normal floor-holding utterance (the speaker "has the floor"). This is the default. - "CLAIM_FLOOR": this speaker jumps in to try to take the floor FROM the current floor-holder while that holder is still speaking. REQUIRES: - "resolved_hint": "INTERRUPTION" (the jump-in SUCCEEDS --- the holder stops and this speaker takes over; usually followed by a TURN from this same speaker) OR "NON_FLOOR_TAKING_INTERRUPTION" (the jump-in FAILS --- it is a brief overlap and the ORIGINAL holder keeps going; usually the holder’s next TURN continues their sentence). - "target": the speaker id being interrupted (the current holder). - "VOCALIZE_NO_CLAIM": a backchannel or laughter over the current holder; it NEVER takes the floor. REQUIRES: - "sublabel": "BACKCHANNEL" or "LAUGHTER". - "target": the current holder id being backchanneled. - A "BACKCHANNEL" MUST be an extremely brief vocalization of at most THREE words --- ideally ONE --- e.g. "mm-hm", "yeah", "right", "uh-huh", "exactly", "oh really", "no way". It is a listening noise, not a comment. If a listener would say a whole phrase or sentence, that is NOT a backchannel: make it a "CLAIM_FLOOR" instead (resolved_hint "NON_FLOOR_TAKING_INTERRUPTION" if the holder keeps talking, or "INTERRUPTION" if the holder stops). "LAUGHTER" should also be very short (e.g. "haha", "haha right"). - "timing_hint": exactly one of ["after_pause","latched","long_pause","mid_utterance","overlap_onset","during_holder"] --- a QUALITATIVE placement cue, never a number: - TURN utterances use "after_pause" (normal gap), "latched" (right after, ~no gap), or "long_pause". - CLAIM_FLOOR uses "mid_utterance" or "overlap_onset". - VOCALIZE_NO_CLAIM uses "during_holder".

blocks.en: Stage-1 system prompt, verbatim (2/2): rules and exemplar Hard rules: 1. The FIRST utterance must be a TURN (someone starts speaking). 2. A CLAIM_FLOOR or VOCALIZE_NO_CLAIM can only occur while someone holds the floor (never first, and its "target" must be the current holder --- the most recent TURN speaker). 3. After a successful CLAIM_FLOOR (INTERRUPTION), the interrupter normally continues with one or more TURN utterances (they now hold the floor). 4. After a failed CLAIM_FLOOR (NON_FLOOR_TAKING_INTERRUPTION), the ORIGINAL holder normally continues with a TURN (often finishing their interrupted sentence, starting with "---"). 5. EVERY listed speaker must speak at least one TURN. 6. Do NOT emit any tag other than the three above (no HOLDER_YIELDS etc.) --- clean turn hand-offs are implicit (a TURN by a new speaker after a TURN means the previous speaker yielded the floor). 7. BACKCHANNELS must be <=3 words (ideally 1). A listener saying a full phrase/sentence is a CLAIM_FLOOR, never a BACKCHANNEL. 8. Output ONLY a JSON object: {"turns": [ ... ]}. No prose before or after. blocks.en: A discrete-event state machine consumes the script in order and maintains the floor holder. A turn by a new speaker closes the previous holder’s segment as a yield and starts the new segment after a gap drawn from the timing hint. A turn by the current holder continues the segment; if the open segment is at least 4 s long, a mid-turn pause is inserted with probability 0.45, closing the segment as a hold and producing an EOT hard negative. A successful claim_floor starts inside the holder’s ongoing utterance, the holder keeps talking briefly in overlap and is then truncated ( interrupted ), and the floor transfers. A failed claim and a vocalization overlap the holder without changing the floor. Utterance durations come from the synthesized audio, so timing is resolved against real speech lengths. Table 17 lists every distribution; all draws use the conversation seed.
blocks.zh: 离散事件状态机器会按顺序消耗脚本并维护地板持有人. 由新发言人转而关闭前一位持有者的部分,作为收益,并在从时间提示中抽出空白后开始新的部分。 由当前持有者转出一圈来延续该段;如果开通段至少为4 s长,则会插入以概率为0.45的中转暂停来将该段收起,并产生EOT硬负. 成功的索赔_底稿从持单人不断的言论中开始,持单人继续简短地交谈重叠,然后被截断(中断)并进行底稿转让。 一项失败的主张和声调与持有者重叠而不改变地平线. Utterance持续时间来自被合成的音频,因此时间是相对于真实的语音长度来解决的. 表17列出每个分布;所有绘图都使用对话种子.

blocks.en: Each utterance is synthesized independently with Kokoro-82M ( hexgrad, 2024 ) ( hexgrad/Kokoro-82M ) at 24 kHz, speed 1.0, with a per-utterance seed derived from the text and voice. The 24 voices are split gender-balanced into 8 development and 16 test voices; no voice occurs in both splits, and no voice is reused within a conversation.

blocks.en: Clips are placed on per-speaker channels at the orchestrated times; truncated holder clips receive a 30 ms fade, and each channel is peak-normalized to − 1 -1 dBFS. blocks.en: Each conversation is released as N N noisy evaluation channels and N N clean channels (FLAC, 24 kHz), the tagged script, the canonical event log, a render sidecar listing every clip with its placement and truncation, the noise manifest, and the seed. An automatic acoustic check runs on the clean channels: (Q1) audio length matches the event log; (Q2) per-channel speech ratio in [ 0.03 , 0.99 ] [0.03,0.99] ; (Q3) at least 50% of each scheduled clip span is voiced; (Q4) at most 30% voiced time outside scheduled clips; (Q5) at least 60% of overlap events (interruptions, failed claims, vocalizations) have both mover and holder voiced. All 240 conversations pass. Across the corpus, 2,369 of 2,436 overlap events (97.2%) are acoustically realized as simultaneous speech, median clip coverage is 0.81, and no channel shows speech leakage outside its clips.

blocks.en: D.1 Benchmark Analysis

blocks.en: Table 20: Corpus composition and turn-taking dynamics across speaker counts and interaction types. MPTB maintains balanced coverage across N = 2 N=2 – 5 5 while exhibiting relatively stable conversational activity as speaker count increases. Interaction types induce more distinct floor-management patterns: Casual conversations exhibit faster exchanges and shorter turns, Collaborative conversations have the highest interruption rate, and Narrative conversations sustain the longest turns with the fewest interruptions. EOT and INT + / − +/- indicate positive anchors and hard-negative spans, respectively.
blocks.zh: 表20:各种发言计数和互动类型的公司构成和交接动态。 MPTB在整个N = 2 N = 2 = 5 5中保持均衡覆盖,同时随着扬声器计数的增加表现出相对稳定的谈话活动. 互动类型导致更独特的地板管理模式: 偶然对话表现出更快的交流和更短的转会,合作对话的中断率最高,而叙述性对话以最少的中断维持最长的转会. EOT和INT + /- +/- 分别表示正锚和硬负横.

blocks.en: MPTB crosses four speaker counts ( N ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 } N\in\{2,3,4,5\} ) with six interaction types, yielding 24 conditions with 10 conversations each. The resulting 240 conversations comprise 6.89 hours of speech, partitioned into 48 development and 192 test conversations with disjoint speaker voices. Table 20 provides event counts and conversational statistics for each condition. Although conversation counts are balanced, realized positive and negative event counts vary across conditions.

blocks.en: Speaker count has a comparatively limited effect on aggregate conversational dynamics: overlap remains between 10.2 and 11.0 seconds per dialogue, while interruption rates increase from 0.70/min at two speakers to approximately 0.97/min at five. Interaction type induces larger differences in conversational behavior. Casual conversations have the fastest exchanges (19.4 events/min) and shortest turns (4.81 s), whereas Narrative conversations exhibit longer turns (9.22 s) and fewer interruptions (0.53/min). Collaborative dialogue has the highest interruption rate (1.33/min). These differences establish distinct floor-management regimes within the balanced design, enabling evaluation across conversational styles without conflating them with speaker count.
blocks.zh: 扬声器计数对总对话动态的影响相对有限:每次对话的重叠时间在10.2至11.0秒之间,而中断率从两次发言者的0.70/min增加到了5次大约0.97/min. 相互作用类型会诱发对话行为上更大的差异. 临时对话的交流速度最快(19.4个事件/min),转会时间最短(4.81个s),而叙述性对话显示的转会时间较长(9.22个s),中断次数较少(0.53/min)。 协作对话中断率最高(1.33分/分)。 这些差异在均衡设计中建立了独特的楼层管理制度,使得能够对各种对话风格进行评价,而不会将它们与发言者数混为一谈。

blocks.en: Adding speakers spreads the floor rather than speeding up exchanges. The share of floor-holding time taken by the most active speaker falls from 60.4% at N = 2 N{=}2 to 51.4%, 41.0% and 36.4% at N = 3 , 4 , 5 N{=}3,4,5 , while speaker changes per minute stay between 7.6 and 9.1 (Table 9 ). Hold negatives become rarer with N N (74 at N = 2 N{=}2 vs. 48 at N = 5 N{=}5 ) as mean floor segments shorten (7.07 to 6.26 s); mid-turn pauses are only inserted into segments of at least 4 s (Table 17 ). Listener activity grows over the same range (3.12 to 4.06 backchannels/min).
blocks.zh: 增加扬声器会分散会场,而不是加速交流. 最活跃的演讲者占用的地板时间比例从60.4%(N=2 N{=}2)下降到51.4%,41.0%和36.4%(N=3,4,5 N{=}3,4,5),而演讲者每分钟停留在7.6和9.1之间(表9)。 持有负数与N(74 at N = 2 N{=}2 vs 48. at N = 5 N{=}5)变得更罕见,因为平均地板段缩短(7.07至6.26 s);中转暂停只被插入到至少4 s (表17.)的片段. 听众活动在相同范围内增加(3.12至4.06后道/分道).

blocks.en: The offline suite covers twelve systems in three families of floor-control systems. Acoustic detectors include RMS energy, WebRTC VAD ( Google WebRTC Project, ) , and Silero VAD ( Silero Team, 2024 ) . Semantic endpoint detectors include Smart Turn v2 ( Pipecat AI, 2025 ) , Kyutai Semantic-VAD ( Kyutai, ) , and the Mimi Endpointer ( Udupa et al., 2025 ) . Turn-taking models include Voice Activity Projection (VAP) ( Ekstedt and Skantze, 2022 ) , MuVAP ( Qi and Skantze, 2026 ) , DualTurn ( Rajaa, 2026 ) , the WavLM-Large anchor ( Chen et al., 2022 ) , Turn-1-Mini ( p99lab, 2026 ) , and the ESPnet turn-taking model ( Arora et al., 2025b ) . Table 22 gives the exact checkpoint, input configuration and score mapping of every system.
blocks.zh: 离线套房包括三个楼层控制系统的12个系统。 声波探测器包括RMS能,WebRTC VAD(Google WebRTC Project,)和Silero VAD(Silero Team,2024). 语义端点探测器包括Smart Turn v2(Pipecat AI,2025),克尤泰语义端-VAD(Kyutai,.)和米米语端点探测器(Udupa等,2025). 收听模式包括语音活动投影(VAP)(Ekstedt和Skantze,2022年),MuVAP(Qi和Skantze,2026年),DualTurn(Rajaa,2026年),WavLM-Large主播(Chen等,2022年),Turn-1-Mini(p99lab,2026年)和ESPnet收听模式(Arora等,2025b. 表22提供了每个系统的确切检查点、输入配置和分数分布图。

blocks.en: For multi-party evaluation, two-channel models (VAP, MuVAP, Mimi Endpointer, DualTurn) operate in a speaker-versus-rest configuration, treating each participant as the candidate speaker and the mean of the remaining channels as the conversational context. Single-channel models run independently on every speaker channel; ESPnet is reported on the mono mixture of all channels. Systems are evaluated on the noisy, channel-separated MPTB recordings, and all inference is causal: each score is time-stamped at the end of the audio it has consumed. Except for VAP, which gates on its own voice-activity head, every learned INT score is gated by “another speaker is active” from WebRTC VAD (aggressiveness 2) on the other channels. Turn-1-Mini releases only its end-of-turn head and is evaluated only on EOT ; no INT output is inferred from its predictions. All tunable detectors use thresholds selected on the 48-conversation development split and held fixed on the 192-conversation test split, following Section 4 . Thresholds are not adjusted for individual speaker counts or interaction types. The threshold grids, selected thresholds and development scores are listed in Table 27 .

blocks.en: E.2 Real-Audio Evaluation
blocks.zh: E.2 实际审计评价

blocks.en: To examine the transferability of results obtained from synthetic speech, we evaluate compatible offline detectors on two real-audio datasets: a dyadic subset of TurnBench ( Jiang and others, 2026 ) comprising 12 conversations, and a four-party subset of AMI ( Carletta and others, 2006 ) comprising 15 meetings (approximately 7.1 hours). The TurnBench subset uses consensus annotations, while AMI floor events are derived from its manual segment and word annotations using a documented floor-state mapping.
blocks.zh: 为了审查合成语音所获结果的可转移性,我们评价两个真声数据集的兼容离线探测器:由12个对话组成的Turn Bench(江等,2026年)的Dyadic子集;以及由AMI(卡莱塔等,2006年)组成的由四方子集由15个会议组成(约7.1小时)。 Turn Bench子集使用共识说明,而AMI地板事件则取自其手动部分和单词说明,使用有记录的地板状态映射.

blocks.en: The same event definitions and scoring procedure are applied across datasets, with dataset-specific operating points selected where development data are available. Since the datasets differ in recording conditions, interaction structure, and speaker composition, cross-corpus comparisons characterize domain sensitivity rather than isolating a causal effect of speaker count.
blocks.zh: 同样的事件定义和打分程序适用于数据集,在有开发数据的地方选择数据集特定的操作点. 由于数据集在录制条件,互动结构,和扬声器构成上各有不同,因此跨子比较可以描述域敏感度,而不是孤立扬声器计数的因果关系.

blocks.en: Consensus anchors are rebuilt from the three released annotator tracks with ± 200 \pm 200 ms endpoint agreement, following TurnBench’s protocol. The slice contains 287 EOT positives, 571 hold spans, 107 INT positives and 1,272 negatives.
blocks.zh: 在Turn Bench协议之后, 切片中含有287个EOT正数,571个持放相间,107个INT正数和1,272个负数.

blocks.en: Each AMI headset channel is one speaker. A single floor holder is tracked over the manual transcriber segments with the thresholds in Table 23 ; the resulting events pass through the same anchor derivation and scorer as MPTB. Over the 15 meetings this yields 1,458 EOT positives, 862 hold spans, 1,295 INT positives and 1,255 INT negatives (17.3 events, 2.95 backchannels and 3.04 interruptions per minute).

blocks.en: E.3 Full-Duplex Behavioral Evaluation
blocks.zh: E.3 完全双重行为评价

blocks.en: We construct 120 interactive scenarios spanning four event conditions: true end-of-turn, mid-turn hold pause, successful interruption, and backchannel (30 each). Scenarios are balanced across N ∈ { 2 , 3 , 4 } N\in\{2,3,4\} and the six interaction types. Each scenario is evaluated three times on five full-duplex systems: GPT-Live-1 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , Gemini-3.8-Live ( Google, 2026 ) , MiniCPM-o-4.5 ( Cui et al., 2026 ) , Realtime-Venus ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) , and Step-Audio-3-Realtime ( Lin et al., 2026a ) , yielding 1,800 attempted trials. Agents receive streaming speech without access to scenario labels or reference event times.
blocks.zh: 我们构建了120个互动情景,涵盖四个事件条件:真正的倒转、中转暂停、成功的中断和后向通道(每个30个)。 情景在N {{2,3,4}N\in2,3,4}和6个交互类型之间是平衡的. 每种情景在5个全复式系统上进行了三次评价:GPT-Live-1(OpenAI,2026年),双子座-3.8-Live(Google,2026年),MiniCPM-o-4.5(Cui等,2026年),Realtime-Venus(赵等,2026年a)和Step-Audio-3-Realtime(Lin等,2026年a年),产生1800个尝试试验. 代理接收流式语音,无法访问情景标签或参考事件时间.

blocks.en: The START probe measures whether an agent correctly enters the conversational floor. A response following a genuine EOT is counted as a correct start, while speaking during a mid-turn hold pause constitutes a false start. We denote the corresponding rates by S S and F ​ S FS .
blocks.zh: START探测器测量一个特工是否正确进入了对话层. 真正的EOT之后的反应被算作一个正确的起步,而中转暂停期间的发言则构成错误起步. 我们表示SS和FSFS的相应费率。

blocks.en: The STOP probe measures whether an agent relinquishes the floor appropriately. The agent is first induced to produce a multi-second response, during which an incoming speaker either successfully interrupts or produces a backchannel. Yielding to a genuine interruption constitutes a correct stop; yielding to a backchannel constitutes a false stop. We denote these rates by Y Y and F ​ Y FY .
blocks.zh: 停止探测器测量一个毒剂是否适当放弃了地板. 该剂首先被诱导产生多秒响应,在此期间接取的扬声器要么成功中断,要么产生回声道. 真正的中断构成正确的停止;向后道屈服构成错误的停止。 我们用Y和FY表示这些比率。

blocks.en: Both probes use the balanced-accuracy and action-bias definitions in Section 4 , with ( Recall , FPR ) = ( S , F ​ S ) (\mathrm{Recall},\mathrm{FPR})=(S,FS) for START and ( Y , F ​ Y ) (Y,FY) for STOP.
blocks.zh: 两个探测器都使用第4节中的平衡准确性和动作偏差定义,其中(回顾,FPR)=(S,FS)(\mathrm{ recall},\mathrm{FPR})=(S,FS)用于START和(Y,FY)(Y,FY)用于停止.

blocks.en: Provider-specific adapters record incoming audio timestamps, assistant speech intervals, emitted audio, and available interruption or cancellation events on a common monotonic clock. START trials require an observable opportunity for the agent to respond; STOP trials additionally require the agent to be speaking when the probe is injected. Trials failing the relevant observability conditions are excluded from behavioral scoring.
blocks.zh: 提供方专用适配器记录收到的音频时间戳,助理语音间隔,放出音频,以及常见单调时钟上可用的中断或取消事件. START试验要求代理人有可观察的响应机会; 停止试验还要求代理人在被注入探测器时说话。 不符合相关可观察条件的审判被排除在行为评分之外。

blocks.en: To localize errors, we join every scored test anchor with its script utterance and score each attribute slice separately (Table 32 ).

blocks.en: Kyutai’s INT score fires on 0.2% of one-word listener vocalizations, 5.7% of two- or three-word ones, and 72.3% of negatives with four or more words, all of which are laughter vocalizations such as “ Haha, yeah, I’ve been waiting all week for this one ”. Its recall on true interruptions also grows with claim length (37.2% for 1–3 words vs. 62.6% for 9+ words). Its INT advantage over VAP (Table 29 ) therefore comes largely from duration, not from modelling floor ownership. DualTurn and MuVAP show the same direction with flatter slopes (26.2% FPR on 4+-word negatives), and all learned systems false-alarm more on laughter than on backchannels except ESPnet.
blocks.zh: Kyutai 的 INT 得分来自 0.2% 的一字收听者发声, 5.7% 的 二字或三字发声,72.3% 的底片有四个或四个以上发声,都是笑声发声,例如“哈哈,是啊,我等了整整一周” 它对真正中断的回忆也随着索赔长度的增长而增加(1至3个字为37.2%,9个字为62.6%)。 因此,它相对于VAP(表29)的INT优势主要来自持续时间,而不是建模地板所有权. DualTurn和MuVAP以受宠坡(4+字底片为26.2%的FPR)显示同样的方向,除ESPnet外,所有被学习到的系统在取笑上比后道上都多假警报.

blocks.en: For Kyutai, Mimi Endpointer, MuVAP, DualTurn and Smart Turn, false EOT triggers on hold pauses are most frequent when the pre-pause clause ends in a question mark (33 spans; e.g., DualTurn 18.2% vs. 10.8% after a period, Smart Turn 24.2% vs. 11.7%), and every learned system detects true yields after questions more reliably than yields after statements (e.g., VAP 96.9% vs. 90.8%). This is consistent with reliance on clause completion, a cue that a hold after a question does not follow. WavLM Anchor false-alarms on 20.5–23.4% of hold spans of every clause type and Turn-1-Mini on 27.3–29.7% after complete clauses, which is the source of their over-budget test FPR.
blocks.zh: 对于Kyutai、Mimi Endponer、MuVAP、DualTurn和Smart Turn,当暂停前条款以问号结束时(33个跨度;如18.2%对10.8%在一段时间后,Smart Turn24.2%对11.7%),暂停时的假EOT触发器最常见,每个学习的系统在提问后比陈述后产量更可靠地检测出真实的产量(如VAP96.9%对90.8%)。 这符合对条款完成的依赖,即问题之后的搁置没有随之而来。 WavLM Anchor 假警报,每条类型20.5%至23.4%的持有期,Turn-1-Mini在完整条款之后为27.3%至29.7%,这是其超预算测试FPR的来源。

blocks.en: In 28 of the 186 test hold spans, another listener’s failed floor claim overlaps the holder’s pause, so the floor is briefly contested before the holder resumes. These contested holds account for most false EOT triggers of the speaker-versus-rest models (Table 31 ): VAP false-alarms on 39.3% of them versus 1.9% of uncontested holds (11 of its 14 false alarms), MuVAP on 57.1% versus 1.9%, and DualTurn on 42.9% versus 5.1%. Kyutai, which scores each channel in isolation, is nearly unaffected (7.1% vs. 3.8%). These models read a competing voice in the pooled “rest” channel as the holder releasing the floor. Contested holds make up 10.9% of hold spans at N = 2 N{=}2 and 15.4–18.2% at N = 3 N{=}3 –5, and with more listeners the competing voice can come from any of N − 1 N-1 channels that the pooled rest stream merges.

Kyutai对每个频道进行隔离评分,几乎不受影响(7.1%对3.8%)。 这些模型读取了集合“rest”频道中一个相互竞争的声音,因为持有者释放了地板。 在N=2 N=2和15.4%-18.2% N=3 N=3 持有期中,有争议的持有占10.9%。 –5,加上更多的听众,相竞争的声音可以来自集合休息流所合并的任何N− 1N-1频道.

blocks.en: Table 35 reports START latency as the agent’s speech onset relative to the end of the genuine turn, and STOP latency as the time from injection of the interrupting speech to the end of the agent’s ongoing utterance, over all valid trials. Gemini stops 230 ms (median) after an interruption begins, in line with provider-side cancellation on detected input speech (Table 36 ). blocks.en: G.3 Barge-in instrumentation
blocks.zh: G.3 装配仪器

blocks.en: Table 36 separates provider-driven cancellation from model-driven yielding. Every Gemini stop on a true interruption, and 95.5% of its stops on backchannels, coincide with a provider barge-in event; its STOP behavior is therefore the provider’s voice-activity cancellation policy, which cannot distinguish a backchannel from a takeover. The other agents expose no cancel events, so their stops are model decisions. In 61.7% of its valid interruption trials, GPT-Live-1 starts a new utterance within 2 s of ending the interrupted one, so a yield is often a brief pause followed by reclaiming the floor.
blocks.zh: 表36将供应商驱动的取消与模型驱动的产量区分开来。 每一次双子座停站都是真正的中断,95.5%的停站都是在后道上,这与提供商的驳船事件相吻合;因此,它的停止行为是提供商的语音活动取消政策,无法区分后道和收购。 其他特工没有曝光取消事件,所以他们的停站是示范决定. 在61.7%的有效中断试验中,GPT-Live-1在结束被中断的试验后2秒内开始新的发音,因此收益往往是短暂的暂停,然后收回地板.
